why: The client asked for two armchairs facing each other and a classic look. A's deep rolled-arm armchairs match the sofa and form a coherent set. B's cream wingbacks are elegant but add a third fabric and style, so the seating is less unified. Both sofas are charcoal grey rather than the dark green velvet requested, so each loses a point there. The rug, table, mirror and lamp are identical in both proposals and suit the room.
